_comment: Which treasure hunt landmarks (the client's PointsOfInterest) each map shows, by map id.
Read once off DofusDB's treasure hunt helper (api.dofusdb.fr/treasure-hunt), the players' own
pairing of maps and landmarks, along every row of the world from the maps this base has outdoors:
tools/extract_hunt_pois.py. 3,947 maps, 166 landmarks. The capture's hunt fits it: its first step,
882 to the south of [2,4], is shown first that way on [2,11] (88081164), seven maps on.
